title: GLG Opens San Francisco Office in the Financial District
summary: GLG opened an office at 595 Market Street in San Francisco's Financial District, creating dedicated service teams for technology, consulting, and finance clients and experts. CEO Gemma Postlethwaite said demand from clients and experts on the West Coast continues to grow; GLG says it has worked with San Francisco clients for more than two decades and describes the office as one of its recent investments in global service capacity.
whyItMatters: A physical West Coast hub puts GLG closer to the technology sector and AI developers — a client base it later targeted directly with the GLG Frontier practice.
